item.title: Remarrying during pendency of first wife’s appeal amounts to Contempt: Punjab and Haryana High Court sentences Man to 3 months jail and fine

item.title: Delhi High Court denies bail to husband in dowry death case over wife’s post-mortem injury and statutory presumption
item.description: Dowry deaths corode societal values, and perpetuate systemic oppression of women, cruelty culminating in the death of a young bride strikes at the collective conscience of society.
